name: What are common storage solutions for an organized garage interior?

mainEntity.name: What are common storage solutions for an organized garage interior?

acceptedAnswer.text: Common storage solutions for an organized garage interior include custom cabinetry, which offers enclosed storage for a clean look, and open shelving systems for easy access to frequently used items. Wall-mounted systems, such as slat walls or pegboards, are excellent for hanging tools, bikes, and sports equipment, keeping floors clear. Overhead storage racks utilize vertical space for seasonal items. Additionally, workbenches with integrated drawers and specialized racks for specific equipment like kayaks or surfboards help maximize organization and functionality.
acceptedAnswer.description: Common garage storage solutions include custom cabinetry, open shelving, wall-mounted systems (slat walls, pegboards), overhead racks, and workbenches to maximize organization.
